questions.prompt: In what year was Jamestown founded?
questions.fact: Jamestown was the first permanent English settlement in America, and it very nearly failed — most of the original colonists died within a year.

questions.prompt: What is the hardest substance in the human body?
questions.fact: Enamel is harder than bone, but unlike bone it contains no living cells — which is why it cannot repair itself.

questions.prompt: The Masters Tournament is one of the biggest events in which sport?
questions.fact: The Masters is the only major played on the same course every year, at Augusta National.

questions.prompt: Which character is the green ogre voiced by Mike Myers?
questions.fact: Shrek was built as a deliberate send-up of the fairy-tale conventions the studio's rivals were selling at the time.

questions.prompt: Who is the narrator of 'The Catcher in the Rye'?
questions.fact: Holden narrates the entire book from what he eventually admits is an institution, which colours everything he tells you.

questions.prompt: What does a read receipt show?
options: That a message was opened or read
questions.fact: It confirms a message was opened, not that it was read or understood — which is why it settles as many arguments as it starts.
